"}</script>

<script id="panorama-fragment" type="x-shader/x-fragment">precision highp float;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uInside;
uniform sampler2D uOutside;
uniform sampler2D uGlass;
uniform vec2 uSpan;
uniform vec2 uEqui;
uniform vec2 uAngles;
uniform vec2 uLook;
uniform vec2 uInsideProjection;
uniform vec3 uGlobe;
// xyz is the globe center in the panorama's room frame; w enables room anchoring.
// A zero default retains the original screen-space API for older renderers.
uniform vec4 uRoomAnchor;
uniform float uAspect;
uniform float uFov;
uniform float uMode;
uniform float uGlassAmount;
uniform float uRoomAmount;
uniform float uInsideKey;
uniform float uInsideAlpha;
uniform float uTime;
// The room analysis supplies a world-space direction TOWARD its brightest light.
// Unset WebGL uniforms are zero, preserving the original rendering by default.
uniform vec3 uRoomLightColor;
uniform vec3 uRoomLightDirection;
uniform float uRoomLightStrength;
const float PI=3.14159265359;
const float TAU=6.28318530718;
// Thin clear glass helpers; GLSL ES 1.00 / WebGL 1.
// All directions and the camera position must be in the fixed globe frame.
// Apply panorama yaw ONLY at texture sampling, after calling these helpers.
// No uniforms, samplers, main(), extensions, derivatives, or time dependence.

vec3 sgGlassRotateY(vec3 p, float yaw) {
    float c = cos(yaw);
    float s = sin(yaw);
    return vec3(c * p.x + s * p.z, p.y, -s * p.x + c * p.z);
}

// Outward normal at the exit intersection for a camera inside the sphere.
// A centered camera has no visible silhouette: every ray meets glass head-on.
vec3 sgGlassExitNormal(vec3 ray, vec3 cameraInGlobe, float radius) {
    vec3 d = normalize(ray);
    float b = dot(cameraInGlobe, d);
    float c = dot(cameraInGlobe, cameraInGlobe) - radius * radius;
    float t = -b + sqrt(max(b * b - c, 0.0));
    return normalize(cameraInGlobe + d * max(t, 0.001));
}

float sgGlassFresnel(vec3 ray, vec3 outwardNormal) {
    float cosTheta = clamp(abs(dot(normalize(ray), normalize(outwardNormal))), 0.0, 1.0);
    float grazing = 1.0 - cosTheta;
    // Schlick, air / clear glass, IOR approximately 1.46.
    return 0.03496 + 0.96504 * grazing * grazing * grazing * grazing * grazing;
}

// A minute, STATIC surface irregularity, rather than a wavy animated filter.
// amount is an angular displacement in radians; try 0.0005 to 0.0014.
// Feed the result into BOTH panorama lookups if they share this pane of glass.
vec3 sgGlassMicroWarp(vec3 ray, float amount) {
    vec3 d = normalize(ray);
    vec3 ripple = vec3(
        sin(d.y * 19.0 + d.z * 8.0) * sin(d.z * 13.0 - d.x * 5.0),
        sin(d.z * 17.0 + d.x * 7.0) * sin(d.x * 11.0 + d.y * 4.0),
        sin(d.x * 23.0 - d.y * 6.0) * sin(d.y * 15.0 + d.z * 3.0)
    );
    ripple -= d * dot(ripple, d);
    return normalize(d + ripple * amount);
}

// Analytic ray / sphere intersections. -1 denotes a miss; there is no marching.
float sgGlassSphereNear(vec3 origin, vec3 ray, float radius) {
    float b = dot(origin, ray);
    float h = b * b - dot(origin, origin) + radius * radius;
    if (h < 0.0) return -1.0;
    float t = -b - sqrt(h);
    return t > 0.00001 ? t : -b + sqrt(h);
}

float sgGlassSphereFar(vec3 origin, vec3 ray, float radius) {
    float b = dot(origin, ray);
    float h = b * b - dot(origin, origin) + radius * radius;
    return h >= 0.0 ? -b + sqrt(max(h, 0.0)) : -1.0;
}

vec3 sgGlassSafeRefract(vec3 ray, vec3 normal, float ratio) {
    vec3 transmitted = refract(ray, normal, ratio);
    return dot(transmitted, transmitted) > 0.00001 ? normalize(transmitted) : reflect(ray, normal);
}

// Air -> glass -> clear cavity -> glass -> air, including both shell walls.
// Returns the near outer hit distance. The cavity ray projects the village.
float sgGlassTraceShell(vec3 origin, vec3 ray, out vec3 normal,
                        out vec3 cavityPoint, out vec3 cavityRay,
                        out vec3 transmittedRay, out float glassPath,
                        out float cavityTransmission) {
    float innerRadius = 0.982;
    float glassIOR = 1.48;
    float cavityIOR = 1.0;
    float t = sgGlassSphereNear(origin, ray, 1.0);
    if (t < 0.0) {
        normal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
        cavityPoint = vec3(0.0);
        cavityRay = ray;
        transmittedRay = ray;
        glassPath = 0.0;
        cavityTransmission = 0.0;
        return -1.0;
    }
    vec3 outerFront = origin + ray * t;
    normal = normalize(outerFront);
    vec3 inGlass = sgGlassSafeRefract(ray, normal, 1.0 / glassIOR);
    float frontWall = max(sgGlassSphereNear(outerFront, inGlass, innerRadius), 0.0);
    cavityPoint = outerFront + inGlass * frontWall;
    vec3 cavityNormal = normalize(cavityPoint);
    float cavityCosine = dot(inGlass, cavityNormal);
    float cavityK = 1.0 - glassIOR * glassIOR / (cavityIOR * cavityIOR) * (1.0 - cavityCosine * cavityCosine);
    cavityTransmission = smoothstep(0.0, 0.008, cavityK);
    if (cavityK <= 0.0) {
        cavityRay = ray;
        transmittedRay = reflect(ray, normal);
        glassPath = frontWall * 2.0;
        return t;
    }
    cavityRay = sgGlassSafeRefract(inGlass, cavityNormal, glassIOR / cavityIOR);
    float cavityLength = max(sgGlassSphereFar(cavityPoint, cavityRay, innerRadius), 0.001);
    vec3 innerBack = cavityPoint + cavityRay * cavityLength;
    vec3 backGlass = sgGlassSafeRefract(cavityRay, -normalize(innerBack), cavityIOR / glassIOR);
    float backWall = max(sgGlassSphereFar(innerBack, backGlass, 1.0), 0.0);
    vec3 outerBack = innerBack + backGlass * backWall;
    transmittedRay = sgGlassSafeRefract(backGlass, -normalize(outerBack), glassIOR);
    glassPath = frontWall + backWall;
    return t;
}

// Background seen from inside the clear cavity through a finite glass wall.
vec3 sgGlassInsideTransmission(vec3 ray, vec3 cameraInGlobe) {
    float t = sgGlassSphereFar(cameraInGlobe, ray, 0.982);
    vec3 p = cameraInGlobe + ray * max(t, 0.0);
    vec3 inGlass = sgGlassSafeRefract(ray, -normalize(p), 1.0 / 1.48);
    float wall = sgGlassSphereFar(p, inGlass, 1.0);
    vec3 outer = p + inGlass * max(wall, 0.0);
    return sgGlassSafeRefract(inGlass, -normalize(outer), 1.48);
}

// A rectangular reflected light with soft edges. Directional, not screen-space.
float sgGlassPanel(vec3 ray, vec3 center, vec2 halfSize, float feather) {
    vec3 d = normalize(ray);
    vec3 n = normalize(center);
    vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), n));
    vec3 up = cross(n, right);
    float facing = dot(d, n);
    vec2 p = vec2(dot(d, right), dot(d, up)) / max(facing, 0.001);
    vec2 a = abs(p);
    vec2 gate = vec2(1.0) - smoothstep(halfSize, halfSize + vec2(feather), a);
    return gate.x * gate.y * smoothstep(0.0, 0.1, facing);
}

// Sparse warm room reflections plus a narrow cool window streak.
// Centers are deliberately behind a forward-looking interior camera, so their
// reflection is visible on the front glass. Rotate this ray with ROOM yaw only
// if lights should move with the room; otherwise leave it in the globe frame.
vec3 sgGlassRoomRadiance(vec3 reflectedRay) {
    vec3 r = normalize(reflectedRay);
    float warmWindow = sgGlassPanel(r, vec3(-0.78, 0.24, -0.58), vec2(0.040, 0.39), 0.045);
    float warmCompanion = sgGlassPanel(r, vec3(-0.66, 0.28, -0.69), vec2(0.012, 0.30), 0.020);
    float coolWindow = sgGlassPanel(r, vec3(0.84, 0.27, -0.47), vec2(0.026, 0.47), 0.040);
    float warmHalo = pow(max(dot(r, normalize(vec3(-0.78, 0.28, -0.55))), 0.0), 26.0);
    float coolHalo = pow(max(dot(r, normalize(vec3(0.85, 0.24, -0.46))), 0.0), 35.0);
    vec3 light = vec3(1.00, 0.73, 0.43) * (1.8 * warmWindow + 0.55 * warmCompanion + 0.11 * warmHalo);
    light += vec3(0.55, 0.77, 1.00) * (1.7 * coolWindow + 0.085 * coolHalo);
    return light;
}

// Clear interior finish. The village retains almost all of its contrast;
// the glass is communicated by sparse glints rather than a grey/blue veil.
// Suggested strength 0.8-1.15. normal = sgGlassExitNormal(...).
vec3 sgGlassInsideFinish(vec3 sceneColor, vec3 rayGlass, vec3 normal, float strength) {
    vec3 d = normalize(rayGlass);
    vec3 n = normalize(normal);
    float f = sgGlassFresnel(d, n);
    float grazing = clamp((f - 0.03496) / 0.96504, 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 reflected = sgGlassRoomRadiance(reflect(d, n));
    vec3 transmission = mix(vec3(1.0), vec3(0.96, 0.992, 1.0), grazing * 0.20 * strength);
    vec3 result = sceneColor * transmission * (1.0 - 0.045 * f * strength);
    result += reflected * f * strength;
    // Very small blue grazing reflection; no overall desaturation or fog.
    result += vec3(0.43, 0.65, 0.92) * grazing * 0.022 * strength;
    return result;
}

// Exterior globe finish. Use the ACTUAL ray-sphere hit normal, not a radial
// screen vignette. The Fresnel rim then follows the sphere naturally.
// roomReflection may come from a sampled room panorama using reflect(ray,n).
vec3 sgGlassOutsideFinish(vec3 globeColor, vec3 roomReflection, vec3 ray, vec3 normal, float strength) {
    float f = sgGlassFresnel(ray, normal);
    float w = clamp(f * strength, 0.0, 0.96);
    vec3 result = mix(globeColor, roomReflection, w);
    result += sgGlassRoomRadiance(reflect(normalize(ray), normalize(normal))) * f * 0.72 * strength;
    result += vec3(0.22, 0.43, 0.58) * pow(clamp((f - 0.03496) / 0.96504, 0.0, 1.0), 0.7) * 0.025;
    return result;
}

// OPTIONAL extraction from the supplied RGB "glass only" image.
// It is NOT an alpha texture: keep only faint bright micro-detail, add it,
// and crop out the source image's exterior sphere rim / base / poles.
// uv must be the sampled source UV, before wrapping. Suggested gain 0.015-0.03.
vec3 sgGlassTextureDetail(vec3 texel, vec2 uv, float gain) {
    float centerX = smoothstep(0.13, 0.27, uv.x) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.73, 0.87, uv.x));
    float centerY = smoothstep(0.12, 0.28, uv.y) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.72, 0.88, uv.y));
    float luminance = dot(texel, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
    float bright = smoothstep(0.32, 0.86, luminance);
    return max(texel - vec3(0.22), vec3(0.0)) * bright * centerX * centerY * gain;
}


// Scene convention: +Z forward, positive yaw right, positive pitch up.
vec3 cameraRay(vec3 d){
 float cp=cos(uLook.y),sp=sin(uLook.y),cy=cos(uLook.x),sy=sin(uLook.x);
 vec3 p=vec3(d.x,d.y*cp+d.z*sp,-d.y*sp+d.z*cp);
 return normalize(vec3(p.x*cy+p.z*sy,p.y,-p.x*sy+p.z*cy));
}
vec3 globeDirectionToWorld(vec3 d){
 if(uRoomAnchor.w>.5&&uMode>.5) return sgGlassRotateY(d,-uAngles.y);
 return cameraRay(d);
}
vec2 panoUV(vec3 d,float angle,float span,float equi){
 float u=fract(.5+atan(d.x,d.z)/TAU+angle/TAU);
 if(equi>.5) return vec2(u,.5-asin(clamp(d.y,-1.,1.))/PI);
 return vec2(u,.5-d.y/max(.015,length(d.xz))/max(span,.01));
}
// One fetch normally; a second only where a clamped source meets its wrap seam.
vec4 texSeamRGBA(sampler2D tex,vec2 uv){
 vec2 p=vec2(fract(uv.x),clamp(uv.y,.0001,.9999));
 vec4 c=texture2D(tex,p);
 float edge=min(p.x,1.-p.x);
 if(edge<.006){
  float f=(1.-smoothstep(0.,.006,edge))*.5;
  c=mix(c,texture2D(tex,vec2(1.-p.x,p.y)),f);
 }
 return c;
}
vec3 texSeam(sampler2D tex,vec2 uv){return texSeamRGBA(tex,uv).rgb;}
float villageCoverage(vec4 layer,vec2 uv){
 // The source contains valid object pixels with alpha around .98, including
 // red decorations and warm masonry. Hue must never change their coverage.
 return mix(1.,clamp(layer.a,0.,1.),clamp(uInsideAlpha,0.,1.));
}
// A shallow surface/ground approximation, without extra samples or geometry.
// worldRay stays in the fixed globe frame; village yaw rotates only its texture.
// Relighting RGB before compositing keeps the supplied alpha and dark gaps exact.
vec3 applyVillageLight(vec3 materialRGB,vec3 worldRay){
 if(uRoomAnchor.w>.5&&uMode>.5) worldRay=sgGlassRotateY(worldRay,-uAngles.y);
 float lightLength=dot(uRoomLightDirection,uRoomLightDirection);
 if(uRoomLightStrength<=0.||lightLength<.0001) return materialRGB;
 vec3 lightColor=clamp(uRoomLightColor,0.,1.);
 float lightLuma=dot(lightColor,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));
 float strength=clamp(uRoomLightStrength,0.,1.)*smoothstep(0.,.12,lightLuma);
 vec3 lightDirection=uRoomLightDirection*inversesqrt(lightLength);
 float materialLuma=dot(materialRGB,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));
 float brightest=max(max(materialRGB.r,materialRGB.g),materialRGB.b);
 float darkest=min(min(materialRGB.r,materialRGB.g),materialRGB.b);
 float chroma=(brightest-darkest)/max(brightest,.05);
 float neutral=1.-smoothstep(.12,.55,chroma);
 float snow=neutral*smoothstep(.36,.74,materialLuma);
 vec3 horizontal=vec3(worldRay.x,0.,worldRay.z);
 horizontal*=inversesqrt(max(dot(horizontal,horizontal),.0001));
 float ground=max(snow,smoothstep(.08,.65,-worldRay.y)*.55);
 vec3 surface=normalize(mix(-horizontal,vec3(0.,1.,0.),.22+.78*ground));
 float diffuse=max(dot(surface,lightDirection),0.);
 // Broad soft spill follows the room light around the globe, never the screen.
 float sourceSide=pow(max(dot(worldRay,lightDirection),0.),2.);
 float response=.22+.48*diffuse+.30*sourceSide;
 vec3 sourceTint=clamp(lightColor/max(lightLuma,.15),vec3(.45),vec3(1.65));
 vec3 tint=mix(vec3(.92,.98,1.08),sourceTint,.25+.75*sourceSide);
 // Multiplicative light retains source contrast and saturated red decorations.
 // At the .65 default, the largest channel gain remains below thirteen percent.
 vec3 gain=vec3(.10*strength*response);
 gain+=(tint-vec3(1.))*(.14*strength*response*neutral);
 return materialRGB*(vec3(1.)+gain);
}
// A restrained reflected room glint supplements the existing clear-glass finish.
vec3 applyRoomGlassLight(vec3 color,vec3 reflectedWorld,float fresnel,float glass){
 float lightLength=dot(uRoomLightDirection,uRoomLightDirection);
 if(uRoomLightStrength<=0.||lightLength<.0001) return color;
 vec3 lightDirection=uRoomLightDirection*inversesqrt(lightLength);
 float lobe=pow(max(dot(normalize(reflectedWorld),lightDirection),0.),22.);
 // A soft directional highlight helps the outside surface read as curved
 // glass while remaining tied to the sampled room light and the glass slider.
 float outsideGlint=uMode>.5?(.065+.16*fresnel):0.;
 float gain=clamp(uRoomLightStrength,0.,1.)*clamp(glass,0.,1.)*(.012+.055*fresnel+outsideGlint);
 return color+clamp(uRoomLightColor,0.,1.)*(lobe*gain);
}
vec3 room(vec3 d){
 vec2 uv=panoUV(d,uAngles.y,uSpan.y,uEqui.y);
 vec3 c=texSeam(uOutside,uv);
 // A complete spherical source contains its own ceiling, floor and nadir.
 if(uEqui.y>.5) return c;
 // Compatibility for the original RGB horizontal strip only.
 float above=1.-smoothstep(-.30,.01,uv.y);
 float below=smoothstep(.99,1.48,uv.y);
 c=mix(c,vec3(.065,.043,.028),above);
 return mix(c,vec3(.095,.052,.026),below);
}
vec3 village(vec3 d,vec3 behind){
 vec2 uv=panoUV(d,uAngles.x,uSpan.x,uEqui.x);
 vec3 clearRoom=mix(vec3(.013,.024,.037),behind,clamp(uRoomAmount,0.,1.));
 if(uEqui.x>.5){
  // Full image, including the real snow underfoot: no crop or synthetic fill.
  vec4 layer=texSeamRGBA(uInside,uv);
  float coverage=villageCoverage(layer,uv);
  return mix(clearRoom,applyVillageLight(layer.rgb,d),coverage);
 }
 vec4 layer=texSeamRGBA(uInside,vec2(uv.x,min(uv.y,.93)));
 vec3 c=layer.rgb;
 float skyGate=1.-smoothstep(.35,.64,uv.y);
 float luminance=dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));
 // Luminance key is exclusively for the original narrow RGB panorama.
 float key=(1.-smoothstep(.012,.10,luminance))*skyGate*uInsideKey*(1.-uInsideAlpha);
 float coverage=villageCoverage(layer,uv)*(1.-key);
 c=mix(clearRoom,applyVillageLight(c,d),coverage);
 float above=1.-smoothstep(-.12,.012,uv.y);
 c=mix(c,clearRoom,above);
 // Original-strip fallback borrows real snowy detail instead of a flat grey fill.
 if(uv.y>.88){
  float azimuth=atan(d.x,d.z);
  float travel=log(1.+max(uv.y-.88,0.)*3.);
  vec2 groundUV=vec2(fract(uv.x+.020*sin(azimuth*3.)+.028*travel),
   .845+.035*sin(travel*1.8+azimuth*.65));
  vec3 snowDetail=texSeam(uInside,groundUV);
  snowDetail=applyVillageLight(snowDetail,d);
  snowDetail*=1.-.12*smoothstep(.2,.95,-d.y);
  c=mix(c,snowDetail,smoothstep(.88,1.18,uv.y));
 }
 return c;
}
vec3 interior(vec3 ray){
 vec3 fixedRay=sgGlassMicroWarp(ray,.00065*uGlassAmount);
 vec3 eye=vec3(.075,-.035,.045);
 vec3 throughGlass=sgGlassInsideTransmission(fixedRay,eye);
 throughGlass=normalize(mix(fixedRay,throughGlass,clamp(uGlassAmount,0.,1.)));
 vec3 outsideColor=room(throughGlass);
 vec3 color=village(fixedRay,outsideColor);
 vec3 normal=sgGlassExitNormal(fixedRay,eye,1.);
 color=sgGlassInsideFinish(color,fixedRay,normal,uGlassAmount*1.8);
 color=applyRoomGlassLight(color,reflect(fixedRay,normal),sgGlassFresnel(fixedRay,normal),uGlassAmount);
 // Sparse fixed surface detail; the source's black and exterior border never mix in.
 vec2 guv=panoUV(fixedRay,0.,.706,0.);
 if(guv.y>.15&&guv.y<.85)
  color+=sgGlassTextureDetail(texSeam(uGlass,guv),guv,uGlassAmount*.016);
 return color;
}

// One analytic conical/cylindrical section of the turned pedestal.
float baseSection(vec3 ro,vec3 rd,float y0,float y1,float r0,float r1,out vec3 normal){
 float slope=(r1-r0)/(y1-y0),rAtOrigin=r0+slope*(ro.y-y0);
 float a=dot(rd.xz,rd.xz)-slope*slope*rd.y*rd.y;
 float b=2.*(dot(ro.xz,rd.xz)-rAtOrigin*slope*rd.y);
 float c=dot(ro.xz,ro.xz)-rAtOrigin*rAtOrigin;
 float best=1000.;normal=vec3(0.,1.,0.);
 float disc=b*b-4.*a*c;
 if(disc>=0.&&abs(a)>.00001){
  float root=sqrt(disc),t0=(-b-root)/(2.*a),t1=(-b+root)/(2.*a);
  float t=min(t0,t1);vec3 p=ro+rd*t;
  if(t>.001&&p.y>=y0&&p.y<=y1){
   best=t;normal=normalize(vec3(p.x,-slope*(r0+slope*(p.y-y0)),p.z));
  }
  t=max(t0,t1);p=ro+rd*t;
  if(t>.001&&t<best&&p.y>=y0&&p.y<=y1){
   best=t;normal=normalize(vec3(p.x,-slope*(r0+slope*(p.y-y0)),p.z));
  }
 }
 if(abs(rd.y)>.00001){
  float t=(y1-ro.y)/rd.y;vec3 p=ro+rd*t;
  if(t>.001&&t<best&&dot(p.xz,p.xz)<r1*r1){best=t;normal=vec3(0.,1.,0.);}
  t=(y0-ro.y)/rd.y;p=ro+rd*t;
  if(t>.001&&t<best&&dot(p.xz,p.xz)<r0*r0){best=t;normal=vec3(0.,-1.,0.);}
 }
 return best;
}
float pedestalHit(vec3 ro,vec3 rd,out vec3 normal){
 vec3 n;float best=1000.;float t;
 t=baseSection(ro,rd,-1.08,-1.045,.66,.75,n);
 if(t<best){best=t;normal=n;}
 t=baseSection(ro,rd,-1.045,-.915,.75,.69,n);
 if(t<best){best=t;normal=n;}
 t=baseSection(ro,rd,-.915,-.88,.69,.74,n);
 if(t<best){best=t;normal=n;}
 t=baseSection(ro,rd,-.88,-.845,.74,.69,n);
 if(t<best){best=t;normal=n;}
 return best;
}
vec3 pedestalColor(vec3 p,vec3 n,vec3 rd){
 vec3 light=normalize(vec3(-.62,.85,-.65));
 vec3 halfVector=normalize(light-rd);
 float diffuse=max(dot(n,light),0.);
 float spec=pow(max(dot(n,halfVector),0.),74.);
 float azimuth=atan(p.x,p.z);
 float grain=.5+.5*sin(azimuth*17.+p.y*78.+sin(azimuth*9.+p.y*19.)*1.5);
 float fine=sin(p.y*340.+sin(azimuth*19.)*2.);
 vec3 walnut=mix(vec3(.095,.030,.012),vec3(.235,.095,.033),.38+.24*grain);
 walnut*=.97+.025*fine;
 vec3 reflectionDirection=reflect(rd,n);
 vec3 reflected=room(globeDirectionToWorld(reflectionDirection));
 reflected=(reflected+room(globeDirectionToWorld(normalize(reflectionDirection+vec3(-.09,.16,.03)))))*.5;
 vec3 wood=walnut*(.52+.82*diffuse)+reflected*(.045+.11*pow(1.-max(dot(-rd,n),0.),4.));
 wood+=vec3(1.,.79,.53)*spec*.30;
 // Two restrained actual metal bands, with the normals of their bevels.
 float brass=max(step(-.882,p.y),1.-smoothstep(-1.052,-1.043,p.y));
 vec3 gold=vec3(.65,.39,.135);
 vec3 metal=gold*(.23+.39*diffuse)+reflected*mix(gold,vec3(.91,.80,.54),.45)*.25;
 metal+=vec3(1.,.85,.58)*pow(max(dot(n,halfVector),0.),110.)*.85;
 // The seated globe casts a narrow occlusion on the top of the mounting ring.
 float topAO=1.-.20*max(n.y,0.)*(1.-smoothstep(.35,.73,length(p.xz)));
 vec3 color=mix(wood,metal,brass)*topAO;
 float lightLength=dot(uRoomLightDirection,uRoomLightDirection);
 if(uRoomLightStrength>0.&&lightLength>.0001){
  vec3 lightDirection=uRoomLightDirection*inversesqrt(lightLength);
  vec3 worldNormal=globeDirectionToWorld(n);
  float roomDiffuse=max(dot(worldNormal,lightDirection),0.);
  vec3 lightColor=clamp(uRoomLightColor,0.,1.);
  float lightLuma=dot(lightColor,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));
  vec3 tint=clamp(lightColor/max(lightLuma,.15),vec3(.45),vec3(1.65));
  float gain=.085*clamp(uRoomLightStrength,0.,1.)*roomDiffuse*smoothstep(0.,.12,lightLuma);
  color*=vec3(1.)+tint*gain;
 }
 return color;
}

void main(){
 vec2 ndc=vUv*2.-1.;float halfFov=tan(uFov*.5);
 vec3 ray=cameraRay(normalize(vec3(ndc.x*uAspect*halfFov,ndc.y*halfFov,1.)));
 vec3 color;
 if(uMode<.5){color=interior(ray);}
 else{
  vec3 background=room(ray);color=background;
  vec2 point=(vUv-vec2(uGlobe.x,1.-uGlobe.y))*vec2(uAspect,1.);
  vec2 q=point/uGlobe.z;
  float r2=dot(q,q);
  // Perspective sphere whose silhouette exactly follows the existing UI radius.
  float distanceToGlobe=3.25;
  vec3 ro=vec3(0.,0.,-distanceToGlobe);
  vec3 rd=normalize(vec3(q/sqrt(distanceToGlobe*distanceToGlobe-1.),1.));
